entitymodel.title: Hardware Assembly Entities
entitymodel.description: Product models, BOM, routing, work orders, serial numbers, work reports and defects

entity.title: Product model
entity.description: A hardware model that is assembled, tested and packed in house

field.name: snPrefix
field.description: Prefix used when serial numbers are generated

field.name: laborRate
field.description: Labour cost per hour used to cost the model, empty means 0

field.name: warrantyMonths
field.description: Warranty in months from the delivery date, 12 when empty

field.name: salePrice
field.description: Typical selling price, used to turn the after sales cost into a percentage

field.name: devStageId
field.description: MFG_STAGE_CONCEPT, DESIGN, PROTOTYPE, TRIAL or MASS, kept independent from the development projects

field.name: currentBomVersionId
field.description: BOM version in use, set when a version is activated

entity.title: BOM line
entity.description: One component of a product model, including its reference designators

field.name: isKeyPart
field.description: Y when the part has to be traced

entity.title: BOM version
entity.description: One BOM version of a product model; the product points to the version in use and change orders point to the versions they introduce

field.name: bomVersionId
field.description: Model code plus version number, e.g. BT5-V2

field.name: versionNo
field.description: Version number, 1 for the first BOM of the model

field.name: effectiveDate
field.description: Date the version was released, empty while it is a draft

field.name: basisVersionId
field.description: Version this one was copied from, so the difference can be traced

field.name: ecoId
field.description: Change order that introduced the version, empty when it was created by hand

entity.title: BOM version line
entity.description: One component of one BOM version, including its reference designators

field.name: isKeyPart
field.description: Y when the part has to be traced

field.name: unitPrice
field.description: Component price per unit, used to cost the BOM

entity.title: Product photo
entity.description: Old single table of product photos. Deprecated: the rows are copied into MfgAttachment on first read

field.name: seq
field.description: Running number inside the model, 1 is the oldest photo

field.name: fileName
field.description: Original file name, cleaned of any path

field.name: imageSize
field.description: Size of the photo in bytes

entity.title: Attachment
entity.description: File attached to any business record of the component: product photo, 3D print photo, delivery receipt, damage photo of a claim. Kept in the database so a redeploy never loses it

field.name: ownerTypeId
field.description: MFG_ATT_PRODUCT, MFG_ATT_DEV_PROJECT, MFG_ATT_WORK_ORDER, MFG_ATT_DELIVERY or MFG_ATT_CLAIM

field.name: ownerId
field.description: Key of the owning record: productCode, projectCode, workOrderId, deliveryId or claimId

field.name: seq
field.description: Running number inside the owner, 1 is the oldest file

field.name: fileName
field.description: Original file name, cleaned of any path

entity.title: Routing operation template
entity.description: Operation template of a product model: assembly, ageing, test, packing

entity.title: Work order
entity.description: Production order for a quantity of one product model

field.name: smtVendorId
field.description: Vendor master record used for shipping material

field.name: bomVersionId
field.description: BOM version the order is built with, empty to follow the product current version

entity.title: Serial number
entity.description: One physical unit of a work order, traced from assembly to shipment

entity.title: Work report
entity.description: Reported labour of one operation: hours and quantities

field.name: sn
field.description: Optional single unit the report belongs to

entity.title: Defect record
entity.description: Non conformance found on one operation, with repair hours

field.name: sn
field.description: Unit the defect was found on

entity.title: Material lot
entity.description: One purchased lot / reel of a component: supplier lot or date code and quantity received

field.name: supplierLot
field.description: Supplier lot / reel / date code printed on the label

field.name: unitPrice
field.description: Purchase price per unit, used for the actual material cost

field.name: inspectStatusId
field.description: Incoming inspection: MFG_IQC_PENDING, MFG_IQC_PASS, MFG_IQC_CONCESSION (use as is) or MFG_IQC_FAIL (cannot be issued)

field.name: rejectedQty
field.description: Quantity rejected by the incoming inspection

field.name: inspectDate
field.description: When the incoming inspection was finished

entity.title: Material issue
entity.description: Components issued to a work order: which lot went into which build

field.name: workOrderId
field.description: Work order the material was issued to

field.name: designators
field.description: Designators covered, when the SMT house reports reel changes

field.name: snFrom
field.description: First serial number covered, when known

field.name: snTo
field.description: Last serial number covered, when known

entity.title: Shipment
entity.description: Material sent to the SMT house or boards received back, with courier details

field.name: directionId
field.description: MFG_SHIP_OUT to the SMT house, MFG_SHIP_IN back to us

field.name: qty
field.description: Kits sent out, or boards received back

entity.title: Replacement during repair
entity.description: Component swapped on one unit during repair or rework, with the old and new lot

field.name: reason
field.description: Why it was replaced, e.g. NO_POWER

entity.title: Delivery order
entity.description: Units shipped to a customer; the delivery date starts the warranty

field.name: customerName
field.description: Customer the units were shipped to

field.name: workOrderId
field.description: Work order the units came from, optional

entity.title: Delivered unit
entity.description: One serial number shipped with a delivery order

entity.title: Test result
entity.description: One measured item of one unit at a test station, imported from the test bench CSV

entity.title: Outsourcing vendor
entity.description: SMT / PCB vendor with the shipping address and the customer code it assigned to us

field.name: vendorName
field.description: Vendor name, matched with the work order SMT vendor

field.name: addressText
field.description: Shipping address, may span several lines

field.name: customerCode
field.description: Customer code the vendor assigned to us, printed on parcels

entity.title: Warranty claim
entity.description: After sales claim of one unit: warranty status is derived from the delivery date

field.name: customerName
field.description: Customer, taken from the delivery order

field.name: deliveryDate
field.description: Date shipped, start of the warranty

field.name: warrantyEndDate
field.description: Delivery date plus the product warranty months

field.name: inWarranty
field.description: Y when the claim arrived inside the warranty

field.name: claimType
field.description: RTN (return and refund), EXCH (exchange), REPAIR or REFUND_ONLY

field.name: tradeNo
field.description: Marketplace order number, e.g. the Taobao trade id

field.name: signedDate
field.description: Date the buyer signed for the parcel, start of the seven and fifteen day windows

field.name: sevenDayDeadline
field.description: End of the seven day no-reason return window: signed date, next midnight plus 168 hours

field.name: afterSaleDeadline
field.description: End of the fifteen day after sales window counted from the signed date

field.name: deductAmount
field.description: Amount deducted for missing accessories or gifts

field.name: freightPayer
field.description: SELLER when we pay the freight, BUYER otherwise

field.name: returnTrackingNo
field.description: Tracking number of the parcel the buyer sent back

field.name: receivedBackDate
field.description: Date the returned unit arrived back at our warehouse

field.name: inspectResult
field.description: QUALITY, NO_FAULT, HUMAN or UNKNOWN after inspection

field.name: vendorClaimStatus
field.description: Claim raised against the SMT house or the component supplier: NONE, SENT or RECOVERED

field.name: buyerRiskLevel
field.description: Risk level the buyer had on the flag list when the claim was opened: WATCH or BLOCK

field.name: repairWorkOrderId
field.description: Repair work order created for this claim

field.name: exchangeDeliveryId
field.description: Delivery order of the replacement unit

entity.title: Buyer risk flag
entity.description: Internal risk list of buyers: only adds a warning before shipping, it never refuses a legal after sales request

field.name: buyerKey
field.description: Key of the buyer, TB:mobile when the mobile is known, TB:N:nick otherwise

field.name: receiverMobile
field.description: Mobile number on the parcel, used as the main matching key

field.name: riskLevel
field.description: WATCH to warn only, BLOCK to require a manual review before shipping

field.name: reasonCode
field.description: FREQ_RETURN, EMPTY_BOX, SWAP, ABUSE_7DAY, FAKE_CLAIM or THREAT

field.name: evidenceNote
field.description: Evidence kept for a possible appeal: screenshots, video files, ticket numbers

field.name: releasedDate
field.description: Date the flag was lifted, so a buyer is never blocked forever

field.name: expiresDate
field.description: Date the flag stops applying on its own, personal data is not kept longer than needed

entity.title: Product development project
entity.description: One new product under development, followed from the concept stage to mass production

field.name: productCode
field.description: Model this project belongs to, empty while the project is only an idea

field.name: trackId
field.description: MFG_TRACK_PCB, MFG_TRACK_FIRMWARE or MFG_TRACK_ENCLOSURE; empty for a project that only uses the stage ladder

field.name: partCode
field.description: Board code, firmware code or enclosure part number this track works on

field.name: stageId
field.description: MFG_STAGE_CONCEPT, DESIGN, PROTOTYPE, TRIAL or MASS

field.name: targetCost
field.description: Target material plus labour cost per unit

field.name: targetPrice
field.description: Target selling price, used to check the margin at each gate

field.name: plannedLaunchDate
field.description: Planned date the model goes on sale

field.name: actualLaunchDate
field.description: Date the model really went on sale, empty until it does

entity.title: Development stage review
entity.description: Gate review of one stage of a development project; passing a gate moves the project to the next stage

field.name: doneDate
field.description: Date the review really happened, empty while the gate is still open

entity.title: Development track step
entity.description: State of one step of one development track. The step catalog (PCB, firmware, enclosure) lives in the code, this table only keeps how far each step got

field.name: projectCode
field.description: Parent project, the track comes from the project

field.name: stepId
field.description: Step of the track, e.g. MFG_PCB_SCHEMATIC or MFG_ENC_PAY

field.name: plannedDate
field.description: When the step should be finished

field.name: vendorName
field.description: Supplier of the step, e.g. the moulding house or the SMT house

field.name: amount
field.description: Money involved: contract value, payment, tooling cost

field.name: qty
field.description: Quantity involved, used by the stock in step to create the material lot

field.name: referenceNo
field.description: Contract number, payment voucher, tracking number

field.name: lotId
field.description: Material lot created when the enclosure went into stock

entity.title: Engineering change order
entity.description: Engineering change of a model under development or in production; applying it can switch the model to a new BOM version

field.name: projectCode
field.description: Development project the change belongs to, empty for a change in production

field.name: changeSummary
field.description: What changes, line by line: which part, which quantity, which operation

field.name: fromBomVersionId
field.description: BOM version in use when the change was raised

field.name: toBomVersionId
field.description: BOM version to switch to when the change is applied

entity.title: Software project ledger
entity.description: One software or design project (firmware, enclosure, host tool, platform...): its estimated size, the parameters used for the estimate and what it really took, so the next estimate can be built on real numbers

field.name: categoryId
field.description: MFG_SW_FIRMWARE, MFG_SW_ENCLOSURE, MFG_SW_HOST, MFG_SW_PLATFORM or MFG_SW_OTHER

field.name: productCode
field.description: Model this work belongs to, may be empty

field.name: devProjectCode
field.description: Development project of this component, may be empty

field.name: deliverySeq
field.description: Nth delivery of this kind, used by the learning curve of the productivity

field.name: ilfCount
field.description: Internal logical files counted for the estimate

field.name: eifCount
field.description: External interface files counted for the estimate

field.name: ufp
field.description: Unadjusted function points, 35 x ILF + 15 x EIF when empty

field.name: swfBase
field.description: Software factor starting value, 1.5 for custom development

field.name: swfReuse
field.description: Adjustment for reusable products and experience, usually negative

field.name: swfPreInvest
field.description: Adjustment for design work already paid for, usually positive

field.name: swfQuality
field.description: Adjustment for a certified quality system, usually positive

field.name: rdf
field.description: Development factor, 1 when nothing special is required

field.name: pdrHoursPerFp
field.description: Productivity in hours per function point, 40 for the estimated function point method

field.name: dayRate
field.description: Price of one person day used for the quote

field.name: taxRate
field.description: VAT rate, 0.06 for a Chinese software service invoice

field.name: dncRate
field.description: Direct non labour cost as a share of the taxed amount, 0.05 by default

field.name: plannedDays
field.description: Person days the estimate gives, kept as a snapshot

field.name: plannedEndDate
field.description: When the work should be finished

field.name: actualHours
field.description: Hours really spent, filled in as the work goes

field.name: actualCost
field.description: Money really spent, e.g. tooling or outsourcing

field.name: quotedAmount
field.description: What was quoted to the customer, to compare with the estimate
